posts.text: Behind the home insurance crisis is a political corruption crisis that causes Republicans to ignore science that their own state universities teach.
Fossil fuel spends billions on Republicans to ignore this problem, deny climate change, and protect “pollute-for-free” for fossil fuel.
This is a cost nightmare, but it’s also a nuisance, hassle, worry and fraud nightmare. And it all begins with climate-driven weather extremes.
Or dumped in state funds like Florida’s Citizens Property Insurance that paid ZERO to 74% of Hurricane Debby claimants. Some insurance.
Or homeowners stranded with sketchy “pop-up” insurers that don’t pay, after all the major insurers left the market.
Or a family scrambling for coverage after receiving a “notice of non-renewal,” or stuck paying for “forced place” insurance on their mortgage.
Behind these brutal cost numbers are human stories: for instance, a young couple whose first home purchase fell apart over this.

Even the WSJ sees the home insurance meltdown. It’s a big expense to start with, so these big increases can be devastating. 🧵
